errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: Cannot reach the server. Check your internet and try again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission for this action.

login.title: Client portal
login.subtitle: Sign in with your email and password.
login.noTrustHelp: Tick it on a shared or public device: you will sign in once, it will not be remembered and you will always be asked for the security code.

browser.title: Confirm this computer
browser.sentHelp: This is the first time you sign in from this computer. Open the email and press "Confirm this computer" (the link is valid for 24 hours). You can open it from your phone.
browser.notSent: The confirmation email could not be sent. Try again in a few minutes.
browser.afterConfirm: Once you confirm it, come back here and sign in again.
browser.confirmDone: Done: this computer is now confirmed.
browser.confirmNext: Go back to the sign-in screen and sign in again from the computer where you tried.
browser.confirmInvalid: The link is not valid or has expired. Try signing in again to receive a new one.

captcha.required: Confirm you are not a robot to continue.
captcha.help: For security, confirm you are not a robot.
captcha.nativeUnavailable: To continue, sign in to the portal from a web browser. The anti-robot check is not available in the app yet.

mfa.verifySubtitle: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app (or a recovery code).
mfa.enrollSubtitle: To protect your account, the portal requires an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Authy…).
mfa.enrollScan: Add this key to your authenticator app and enter the code it shows.
mfa.recoveryHelp: Keep them somewhere safe: they work if you lose your phone and are shown only this once.

legal.title: Privacy Policy and Terms of Use
legal.lead: To continue, read the whole document and accept it. If it changes, you will be asked again.
legal.scrollHint: Scroll to the end of the text to be able to accept.
legal.accept: I accept the privacy policy and the terms of use
legal.decline: I do not accept, sign out

lock.title: App locked
lock.help: Use your fingerprint (or your phone PIN) to open the portal.
lock.failed: Could not verify. You have {left} attempts left before the password is asked for.

order.title: Order
order.noTimeline: There are no status changes yet.

notices.title: Notices
notices.help: The summaries your delivery company set up to send you.

settings.title: Settings
settings.biometricHelp: When you reopen the app or after a few minutes in the background, you will be asked for your fingerprint (or phone PIN) instead of the password.
settings.biometricNotEnrolled: This phone has no fingerprint registered. Register one in the phone settings to open with fingerprint.
settings.biometricUnavailable: Open with fingerprint is not available on this device.
settings.computersHelp: From these computers you sign in without email confirmation (30 days without use).
settings.computersEmpty: There are no trusted computers yet.

install.title: Put it on my desktop
install.help: Install the portal as an app, with its icon on your desktop or home screen.
install.ios: On iPhone and iPad: tap the Share button and choose "Add to Home Screen".

track.title: Where is my order?
track.help: Enter your package waybill number to see which stage it is in.
track.tooMany: Too many requests in a row. Wait a minute and try again.
track.privacy: We only show the progress of the package: never names, addresses or phone numbers.
track.portalLink: Are you a client? Sign in to the portal

prefs.themeHelp: Automatic follows your phone or browser.

messages.help: Your conversation with the customer service team. Only you and the team can see it.
messages.empty: No messages yet. Write to the team below.
messages.tooMany: Too many messages in a row; please wait a while before writing again.

newOrder.title: New order
newOrder.help: Fill in the basics only; the order goes straight into the normal flow and you follow it from “Orders”.
newOrder.readOnly: Your user can only view. Ask an administrator at your company to let you create orders.
newOrder.name: Name
newOrder.pickupDefault: Where it is usually picked up

errors.consignee: Choose the consignee or enter a new one (name, address and city).
errors.pieces: Pieces must be a whole number, 1 or more.
errors.cod: The amount must be a number.
errors.date: Write the date as YYYY-MM-DD, today or later.
